text: Dead loads: self weight from actual densities (reinforced concrete 25 kN/m3, structural steel 78.5 kN/m3, engineered fill 20 kN/m3); permanent equipment loads, piping, cable trays, insulation, cladding and fireproofing shall be taken from the equipment weights in the database and the vendor drawings; where not yet known an allowance of 1.5 kN/m2 on platforms and 0.5 kN/m2 on roofs shall be added and tracked as an open item.
